bosses.name: Vegeta
bosses.location: At the far edge of the map past the Alien Raid — climb the cliffs and walk into the opening in the mountain
bosses.intro: The World 1 secret boss is Vegeta, labelled Saiyan Prince in game. He's the one most players find first, and he's worth coming back to: his accessory is an Energy roll, and his avatar is the first big Energy multiplier you can farm.
steps: Spawn in Alien Planet and head straight until you reach the Alien Raid.
Jump over the raid area and keep going to the very edge of the map.
Climb the cliffs there. The mountain has an opening you can walk into, and Vegeta is sitting inside.
bosses.avatarDrop: Saiyan Prince avatar — 8x Energy, 0.01%, drops only once
tips: Kill him as soon as your team can — the accessory always drops, so even early kills are progress.
Every kill re-rolls the Scouter's rarity (Common → Secret). Keep the best one and keep farming.
SMG Infinity's run showed him at about 750M HP; he's the easiest secret boss to camp for the 0.01% avatar.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is the secret boss in World 1 of Anime Breaker?
faq.a: Past the Alien Raid at the edge of the map. Climb the cliffs and walk into the opening in the mountain — Vegeta (Saiyan Prince) is inside.

faq.q: What does the Saiyan Prince avatar do?
faq.a: It gives 8x Energy. The drop chance is 0.01% and it only drops once.

sources: SMG Infinity — How to Find ALL SECRET BOSS Locations (16 Oct 2026)
KiraX Blox — All Secret Boss Locations (6 Oct 2026)

bosses.name: Levi
bosses.location: Behind the Titan energy gear near spawn — go to the far corner, climb the cliffs and walk through the gap in the wall
bosses.intro: Levi (Ace Captain in game) is the World 2 secret boss and the first one that's worth a long camp. His accessory is a Damage cape, and his avatar jumps from Vegeta's 8x to 12x Energy.
steps: Right after you enter Titan District, turn right and go behind the Titan energy gear.
Keep going to the very corner of the map and climb the cliffs.
Look for the opening in the wall and walk through. Levi is behind it.
bosses.avatarDrop: Ace Captain avatar — 12x Energy, 0.01%, drops only once
tips: The cape drops every kill; only the rarity changes. It was the best back-slot Damage accessory when SMG Infinity recorded.
The 12x Energy avatar is the reason players stay in World 2 long after unlocking the next portal.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is Levi in Anime Breaker?
faq.a: In Titan District. Turn right after entering, go behind the Titan energy gear to the corner of the map, climb the cliffs and walk through the gap in the wall.

faq.q: What does the Levi (Ace Captain) avatar give?
faq.a: 12x Energy, at a 0.01% drop chance. It only drops once.

sources: SMG Infinity — How to Find ALL SECRET BOSS Locations (16 Oct 2026)

bosses.name: Kakashi
bosses.location: Behind the Hokage building — go round the back and walk into the opening in the carved-faces mountain
bosses.intro: Hidden Leaf's secret boss is Kakashi, called Copy Ninja in game. He drops the Ninja Vest, a Gold accessory, so he's the boss to farm when card spins are what's holding you back.
steps: Spawn in Hidden Leaf and find the Hokage building, the big main building ahead of you.
Go around to the back of it — jump over or walk around, either works.
Behind it is the mountain with the carved faces. There's an opening into the mountain; go inside and Kakashi is there.
bosses.avatarDrop: Copy Ninja avatar — 0.01%, drops only once
tips: If walking into the opening doesn't take you through, dash into it instead — an earlier creator run needed the dash.
The Ninja Vest is a Gold roll (SMG Infinity: double Gold). Stack it with Gold events and potions for faster card spins.
The Copy Ninja avatar is in the drop panel at 0.01%, but no footage we checked shows its multiplier, so we don't list one.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is Kakashi in Anime Breaker?
faq.a: In Hidden Leaf, behind the Hokage building. Walk into the opening in the carved-faces mountain behind it.
Yes — the Copy Ninja avatar, at 0.01%, drops only once. Its multiplier isn't confirmed here yet.

sources: SMG Infinity — How to Find ALL SECRET BOSS Locations (16 Oct 2026)

bosses.name: Escanor
bosses.location: In a small cave by the waterfall — head to the bridge, then look left instead of crossing
bosses.intro: The Sin Village secret boss is Escanor, labelled Lion Sin in game. (This page used to call him Meliodas — the in-game name and the avatar both say Lion Sin, so we've fixed it.) His avatar is 27x Energy, more than three times Vegeta's.
steps: Head toward the bridge in Sin Village.
Don't cross to the right — look left, toward the waterfall.
On the far side of the waterfall there's a small cave. Walk in and the Lion Sin is waiting.
bosses.avatarDrop: Lion Sin avatar — 27x Energy, 0.01%, drops only once
tips: One of the easiest secret bosses to find without a guide — the waterfall cave is a classic hiding spot.
SMG Infinity called his back accessory the best Energy accessory at the time of recording.
The 27x avatar is a long Drop-potion session at 0.01%. Stack a Drop potion and the 1.5x Drop mount before camping.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is the Sin Village secret boss?
faq.a: In a small cave on the far side of the waterfall. Go to the bridge, look left, and walk into the cave.

faq.q: Is the World 4 boss Meliodas or Escanor?
faq.a: Escanor. The game labels him Lion Sin, and his avatar is the Lion Sin avatar (27x Energy).

sources: SMG Infinity — How to Find ALL SECRET BOSS Locations (16 Oct 2026)

bosses.name: The Goliath
bosses.location: On the top floor of the building next to the giant crystal by the ant progression machine — climb the crystal and jump in
bosses.intro: Hunter City's secret boss is The Goliath, and he's the one most players can't find on their own. The route is a climb up a huge crystal and a jump into a building. His avatar is 40.5x Energy and his accessory, Antares Armor, is a Damage piece.
steps: Find the ant progression machine. It's near the red car.
Next to it is a giant crystal. Climb it — hug the crystal as tightly as you can while jumping. It looks impossible at first, but you can reach the top.
From the top, jump onto the upper floor of the building next to it and go inside. The Goliath is there.
bosses.avatarDrop: The Goliath avatar — 40.5x Energy, 0.01%, drops only once
tips: The crystal climb is the hard part. If you keep sliding off, get closer to the crystal before each jump.
Antares Armor was the best Damage accessory when SMG Infinity recorded (mid-October). Newer worlds may top it.
SMG Infinity called the 40.5x avatar one of the hardest to get — it's 0.01%, so plan for a long session.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is the Hunter City secret boss in Anime Breaker?
faq.a: Find the ant progression machine near the red car, climb the giant crystal next to it, then jump onto the top floor of the building and go inside. The boss is The Goliath.
Antares Armor (100%, Damage), Gold, a 5% Hunter Raid Ticket and a 0.01% avatar worth 40.5x Energy.

bosses.name: Fire Fist
bosses.location: At the first windmill on your right after you spawn — no climbing needed
bosses.intro: Pirate Village's secret boss is Fire Fist — Ace from One Piece. He's one of the easier ones to reach: turn right when you spawn. He drops the Fire Fist Hat, a Gold accessory, and a 60.75x Energy avatar.
steps: Spawn in Pirate Village and turn right straight away.
Head to the first windmill on that side. You don't need to climb to the top of it.
Fire Fist is right there at the windmill.
bosses.avatarDrop: Fire Fist avatar — 60.75x Energy, 0.01%, drops only once
tips: The Fire Fist Hat is a head-slot Gold accessory (2x in the inventory panel). Pair it with Kakashi's Ninja Vest and the Anti Magic Wing for a full Gold setup.
Easy to reach, so it's a good boss to leave running on auto while you do other things nearby.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is the Pirate Village secret boss?
faq.a: Turn right as soon as you spawn and go to the first windmill. Fire Fist (Ace) is there.

faq.q: What does Fire Fist drop in Anime Breaker?
faq.a: The Fire Fist Hat (100%, Gold), Gold, a 5% Pirate Raid Ticket and a 0.01% avatar worth 60.75x Energy.

sources: SMG Infinity — How to Find ALL SECRET BOSS Locations (16 Oct 2026)
bosses.imageAlt: Fire Fist View Drops panel: 0.01% avatar (60.75x Energy, drops only once), 100% Random Accessory [Pirate Village], Gold and a 5% Pirate Raid Ticket

bosses.name: Anti Magic
bosses.location: At the very top of the big magic tower — climb via the trees with a mount, double jump and dash
bosses.intro: Clover Village hides Anti Magic — Asta from Black Clover — at the top of the main magic tower. Getting up there is a parkour job. His avatar is 91.12x Energy, and the Anti Magic Wing is a Gold accessory.
steps: Find the big magic tower in the middle of Clover Village. The boss is at the very top.
Jump onto one of the trees next to the tower to start the climb.
Get on your mount for extra speed, double jump toward the tower, then dash. No mount, or it's too slow? Double jump and spam your dash key (Q) instead.
Keep going until you're on top — Anti Magic is waiting there.
bosses.avatarDrop: Anti Magic avatar — 91.12x Energy, 0.01%, drops only once
tips: On keyboard the climb is fairly easy. On phone it's harder — the mount plus dash is what makes the gap.
The Anti Magic Wing is a Gold roll (SMG Infinity: double Gold), so it belongs in a Gold setup with the Ninja Vest and Fire Fist Hat.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is the Clover Village secret boss?
faq.a: At the top of the main magic tower. Climb from the trees beside it using your mount, a double jump and dash.

faq.q: What does the Anti Magic avatar give?
faq.a: 91.12x Energy at a 0.01% drop chance. It only drops once.

sources: SMG Infinity — How to Find ALL SECRET BOSS Locations (16 Oct 2026)
bosses.imageAlt: Anti Magic View Drops panel: 0.01% avatar (91.12x Energy, drops only once), 100% Random Accessory [Clover Village], Gold and a 5% Clover Raid Ticket

bosses.name: CCG Reaper
bosses.location: Up an invisible ladder in a corner of Ghoul City — climb to the top, turn right, then drop down into the hall
bosses.intro: Ghoul City's secret boss is the CCG Reaper — Arima from Tokyo Ghoul. The route uses a ladder you can't see. His avatar is the biggest in the game so far at 136x Energy, and he drops the Ghoul Mask, a Damage accessory.
steps: Turn auto-tap off first. With it on your character keeps walking and the climb gets annoying.
Walk into the corner where the hidden ladder is. You won't see an outline, but walking into it starts the climb.
Climb all the way to the top, turn right, and head down into the hall (DomiBlox: stay right to the top, then jump down the hole).
The CCG Reaper is down there.
bosses.avatarDrop: CCG Reaper avatar — 136x Energy, 0.01%, drops only once
tips: DomiBlox's verdict: the avatar, the mask, Gold and Ghoul Raid Tickets make him the best farm in Ghoul City.
The Ghoul Mask is a Damage roll (SMG Infinity: 2x Damage).
SMG Infinity's maxed avatar showed level 20 — the avatar levels up, so it keeps getting better after the drop.
Every secret boss accessory has a Secret pity of 10,000 kills — the counter shows in the drop tooltip (e.g. 943/10,000).

faq.q: Where is the Ghoul City secret boss in Anime Breaker?
faq.a: Turn off auto-tap, climb the invisible ladder in the corner, go right at the top and drop down into the hall. The boss is the CCG Reaper.

faq.q: What is the best avatar in Anime Breaker?
faq.a: Of the secret boss avatars, the CCG Reaper's 136x Energy is the highest so far.

sources: SMG Infinity — How to Find ALL SECRET BOSS Locations (16 Oct 2026)

petRules: Each world ships its own pet gacha ('Power' units) on top of the companion card.
A Mythical Power unit is worth 3x Energy; a Secret unit up to 6x (wiki-verified).
A Broken-rarity pet sits above Secret — creator-measured at 150x Energy (single source, treat as approximate).
Simultaneous spins let you hatch up to 5 eggs at once.

mechanics: Race Coins drop from regular enemies (~20% on Alien Planet NPCs) and feed the Races gacha.
Your race is a permanent multiplier slot that stacks with companions, pets, accessories and everything else.
Auto Spin is supported; hover each slot in the Races window to see the boost it rolls.
Re-roll whenever your coin balance comfortably exceeds what you would lose.
races.note: The full race list is not published anywhere we could verify. Three races are confirmed from gameplay footage; the rest are marked as a gap, not guessed.

mechanics: Portals drop in the Hunter raid; open one from your inventory and clear its waves to earn Shadows.
Shadows drop at every portal rank — higher ranks mean better odds.
Shadows come in combat types (Warrior, Healer, Tank) with their own stat lines.
Merge duplicate Shadows upward — Mythical merges into Secret — and a pity guarantees progress.
Shadow passives (rolled separately, e.g. 'Elite') add an Energy multiplier on top.
A shadow enchant gacha rolls up to 6x Energy at Secret rarity.
Portal upgrades (portal coins) raise portal level, up to 50 levels each.
shadows.note: Added in Update 1 alongside Hunter City. Shadow Monarch and Ant King are confirmed by creator footage; the full shadow roster is a known gap.

mechanics: Unlocking the Class Tree costs 1.08 Qi Gold (in-game unlock dialog).
Six branches grow from the center; new branches grow out of the first one. Drag and zoom to explore.
Nodes increase your multipliers; unlocking nodes costs Hunter class coins.
Hunter class coins drop in Hunter City and in the Hunter raid portals.
Awakening a class costs 1,000 coins (creator-observed); further nodes run about 5,000 each.
Nodes can also be bought with Gems.
classTree.note: The individual class names on the tree are not yet published in any verifiable source. That list is a gap we are filling from gameplay, not from guesswork.

mechanics: Unlocking the totem costs 41.3T Gold (in-game unlock dialog).
10 stages; each stage needs 10 Commandment Fragments and the cost grows every stage.
Stage rewards include Energy, Damage, Gold, card luck, card speed, card spins, gacha luck, crit damage — and +1 hero equip slot.
A fragment appears around Sin Village every 30 minutes, stays for 15 minutes, then vanishes.
Each player gets their own fragment at a random spot; one fragment per appearance.
Fragments stop appearing once your totem is maxed.

redeemSteps: Finish the tutorial — the Shop stays locked until you clear it.
Open the Shop and look for the small ticket icon at the bottom-left, next to the F2P Info button.
The redeem panel opens on top of the Exclusive Shop — if you only see packs and a countdown timer, you are in the wrong panel.
Enter the code exactly as written (codes are case-sensitive) and confirm.
